content.text: {"what_it_is":{"claims":[{"text":"The Medium Landing Ship (LSM) program is a U.S. Navy shipbuilding effort, funded through the Shipbuilding and Conversion, Navy account.","citation":{"fact_id":"d28cf865234c534a"}}]},"why_it_matters":{"claims":[{"text":"For fiscal year 2026, the program has a total budget request of about $1.96 billion (roughly $1,963,941 thousand), a substantial commitment to constructing this new class of Navy ships.","citation":{"fact_id":"d28cf865234c534a"}}]},"players":{"claims":[]},"recent_developments":{"claims":[]}}
